paite: Huchi in unau siangthou, van sapna tanpihte aw, i thugin toh kisai a Sawltak leh Siampu Lian, Jesu ngaihtuah un;
heading: Mosi Sang A Heutu Thupizaw
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

paite: Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a Mosi amuanhuai mah bang a, amah seppa lak a muanhuaipa.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

paite: Inn sung a papen a-inkuante sang a apahtawi zawk bang un, amah Mosi sang a thupi zawk semna mu dia kilawm a seh ahita hi.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

paite: Inkuan chih in papen kuahiam anei chiat ngal ua; bangkim pa pen bel Pathian ahi.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

paite: Huan huai nung a thugen lai dingte theihsakna ding in, Mosi Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a nasempa in zaw amuanhuai ngei hi.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

paite: Khrist bel Pathian inkuante tung a Tapa in amuanhuai hi. Atawp tan a i kingakna a, i lametna ziak a kipahna, kiptak a i vomhoih photleh, eite a-inkuanpihte i hi uhi.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

paite: Huchi in Kha Siangthou gen bang in, “Tuni a a-aw na zak chiang un,
heading: Lungtang Khauhsak Kei Un
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

paite: Gamdai a ze-etna ni a ahel bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un;
english: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

paite: huai lai ah na pi-le-pute un hon ze-et in ahon khem ua, kum sawmli sung a ka thilhihte amu uhi.
english: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

paite: Huchi in huai suante tung ah ka lung hita kei a, 'Alungtang un angaihtuah khial gige ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uh,' ka chi hi.
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’

paite: Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," chi in.
english: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’” Psalm 95:7-11

paite: Unaute aw pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw Pathian hing tawpsan ding in na lak uah kuapeuh sung ah ginlouhna lungtang gilou ahong om kha ding hi.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

paite: "Tuni," achih lai un niteng in kihanthawntuah zaw un, huchi a na lak ua mi kuamah khelhna khemhat ziak a hihkhauh a na omlouhna ding un.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

paite: I kingakna kipatna pen atawp tan a kiptak a i vomhoih photleh Khrist a tan neite i hita uhi.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

paite: "Tuni in a-aw na zak chiang un ahel lai bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," akichih lai teng.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.” Psalm 95:7-8

paite: Ahihleh kuate ahi ua thei napi a helte? Aigupta a kipan a Mosi pipawt tengteng hilou uhia?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

paite: Kuate tung ah ahia, kum sawmli sung alunghih louh? Hihkhialte aluang uh gamdai a pukmangte tung ah hilou hia?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

paite: Thumangloute kiang ah kia lou ngal kua kiang ah ahia akhawlna a lut lou ding a akichiam?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

paite: Huchi in ginlahna ziak in alut theita kei uh chih i thei uhi.
english: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
